energy-spike.title: What if energy prices jump?
energy-spike.context: Energy prices can spike after a war or a supply cut, as they did in 2022.

fuel-shortage.title: What if fuel goes up?
fuel-shortage.context: A supply crunch or a refinery outage can push pump prices up within weeks.

food-drought.title: What if a drought pushes food prices up?
food-drought.context: A poor harvest shows up in food prices over the following months.
